turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. At night in a closed superstore he hides on top of a tall shelf. A bowling ball and an apple are teetering on a plank at the edge, right above a government agent who is walking below and has not noticed. Peek holds both hands out toward them, frozen, terrified, and whispers to himself so the agent cannot hear: a tiny, shaky, breathless whisper, pleading with the plank, then bracing for the worst. Fully voiced enough to be understood on a phone speaker.
turns.text: Stay... <short pause> stay... <long pause> If it goes... heavy one first... <short pause> then the apple...
